# Report requirements for the authoring subject

The local result is a compact evidence envelope. It must retain the source
identity, the fixed schema, the `authoring-qualification` label, provenance and
the explicit unknown list. A successful local result means only that this
bounded source contract was present and read. The customer-facing wording must
say that native QuaLib qualification, production Library facts and Wave 2 E1--E4
claims are outside this Pack's TEST.
